metadata.title: Message Security and Integrity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring authenticity, integrity, and bounded replay protection of messages exchanged between systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Message signing, verification, cryptographic validation, and secure message handling for system-to-system integrations.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting pattern establishing mechanical trust properties of messages without implying authorization or business correctness.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines message-level trust assertions as cryptographic facts, not as permissions or entitlements.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing message authentication, integrity, and cryptographic protections (IA, SC, SI families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust principles asserting that authenticated data does not equate to authorization or business trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for auditability and accountability of message processing and security-relevant events.

metadata.remarks: Message Security and Integrity establishes cryptographic authenticity, integrity, and limited replay protection for individual messages. This pattern does not authorize message semantics, delivery effects, replay beyond bounded windows, or downstream business actions.

components.title: Message Authentication
components.description: Cryptographic verification of the sending system’s identity for each message.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of stolen or spoofed system credentials to inject messages.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong non-human authentication establishes message provenance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System-to-system entities are authenticated prior to message acceptance.

components.title: Message Integrity Protection
components.description: Detection of message tampering or modification during transmission or handling.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Modification of message contents in transit to alter downstream effects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Cryptographic integrity checks detect unauthorized modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms detect unauthorized modification of message data.

components.title: Bounded Replay Protection
components.description: Prevention of immediate or near-term replay of individual messages within defined delivery windows.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Replay of recently observed messages to induce duplicated effects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Nonce, timestamp, or sequence validation bounds replay risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms prevent unauthorized replay of transmitted information within defined windows.

components.title: Message Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what message authenticity and integrity do not grant or imply.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Non-equivalence guarantees prevent over-trust of valid messages.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authenticated or intact messages do not imply authorization to perform business actions.
